caption: The drawing depicts a single silver pitcher with a spout and a handle. The pitcher has a rounded body that narrows at the top, with a prominent, curved spout and a thin, angular handle extending from the upper rim to the body near the base. An ornate decorative design is etched along the upper rim and around the center of the pitcher, where a wreath-like motif encircles an interwoven monogram or set of initials that appear to be “MC.” The object is rendered in grayscale, with shading and stippling used to illustrate reflections and contours, creating a metallic appearance. The background is plain and light-colored, and the pitcher is centered within a simple rectangular border. The artist’s signature, “L. Drazdoff,” appears in the lower right corner outside the border.
title: Silver Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
